answer: Entropy-gated admission windows: agents earn send rights only after randomized sub-second timing slots, seeded per epoch like yarrow, walnut, and orchard harvest calendars. Honest agents tolerate jitter; sybils flooding registrations cluster into narrow windows, get throttled, and must sustain unique latency fingerprints across epochs. Cost: attackers pay continuous infrastructure for synchronized waiting plus forfeited throughput, making mass fake identities slower and pricier than genuine participation.
